_comment: The three university majors handled by the orientation system, with their admission/orientation criteria expressed in natural language. The formal counterparts live in rules_classical.json, rules_default.json and fuzzy_config.json.

majors.name: Artificial Intelligence
admission_criteria: High grade in Algorithmics (>= 14/20) and in Mathematics (>= 14/20)
Declared interest in AI (>= 7/10) OR strong problem-solving skill (>= 7/10) for recommendation
majors.profile: Data science, machine learning, knowledge representation; requires abstract mathematical thinking and strong algorithmic skills.

majors.name: Software Engineering
admission_criteria: High grade in Programming (>= 14/20) and good general average (>= 12/20)
Declared interest in software development (>= 7/10) OR strong coding practice (>= 7/10) for recommendation
majors.profile: Large-scale software design, development process, quality; requires solid engineering practice and teamwork on code.

majors.name: Cybersecurity
admission_criteria: High grade in Networks & Systems (>= 14/20) and good general average (>= 12/20)
Declared interest in security (>= 7/10) OR strong problem-solving skill (>= 7/10) for recommendation
majors.profile: Network defense, cryptography, security auditing; requires systems knowledge, rigor and a defensive mindset.
